_meta.description: Mage-line skills of the Chinese version (杖剑传说), tiers 1-8, collected from CN player guides (no clean BWIKI skill table exists). Forecast for the global game, tier C at best. type: technique = 战技 (active), charm = 秘法 (passive); null where the guide does not say. en_name_official=true: the English name is a global skill name from our own data, matched to the Chinese name by meaning and role (an inference, not a confirmed mapping). en_name null: no global name known; our translation is in notes. In CN, thunder (雷) skills count as Light. rarity is null throughout: CN guides give the upgrade track (blue, purple, orange, gold, red, rainbow), not a base rarity per skill. Tier is the tier the CN guide files the skill under; where a guide only mentions the skill in a later-tier build the tier is the earliest tier seen and may be too high.

skills.effect: 0-cooldown water shot; in later tiers used to stack Water Momentum quickly and to kite.
Usable on the opening turn; still used at tier 8 as a third water action per turn.
Extra-damage passive with a low trigger rate; fallback when Water Momentum is not wanted.
Crit filler: taken when crit rate from gear is too low, dropped once crit is capped.
Freeze passive of the water build.
Tier-1 summon used only to pull enemies.
Damage passive for mixed-element ("fruit platter") builds. Idle at tiers 4-5, needed again by the tier-6 mixed build together with Myriad Sigil; conflicts with Formation Breaker.
0-cooldown thunder skill; applies Shock; kiting and swing slot up to tier 6.
Core defence passive that works through evasion, not shield size.
Removes enemy buffs (for example a Knight shield) so that block can be broken.
Offensive wind passive taken for extreme stage pushing.
Extra-damage passive; low trigger rate, weaker than Radiance Sear.
2-turn cooldown multi-hit thunder; up to 16 hits on a Hieromon; AoE with target lock, at least 3 hits. Called 天雷; used from tier 3 to tier 6, retired at tier 7.
Extra light damage on multi-hit skills and a chance to Blind. All-round damage passive from tier 3 to tier 6; replaced by Gale (烈风) at tier 7.
Reduces cooldown by 1 turn and adds damage. Pandarial supplies the same effect, which frees this slot.
High-multiplier fire strike ("meteor"); at tier 8 used as the burn-tile trigger for Flame Domain. Replaced in Light-Fire builds by Dark Fire at tier 6.
Knockback passive; mandatory against Duelist and Knight opponents in PvP at every tier. A "plus" version at tier 8 triggers reliably below 10% HP.
1-turn-cooldown pull; drags a Decoy Clone to the boss; fits the water "fridge" passive.
Used for positioning in PvP when a teammate already brings Formation Breaker.
Light damage passive, "nice to have".
Old multi-hit trigger with low damage; the multi-hit added-damage style is obsolete by tier 4.
Old multi-hit trigger with low damage; obsolete by tier 4.

Pure damage support: large attack bonus for the team and a chance to advance the team's action bar. Top investment priority from tier 4 to tier 8 ("the only skill that keeps its value before tier 6"); its base value falls at tier 8. Cannot be combined with Elemental Harmony builds; dropped against Knights.
skills.notes: CN guides treat it as a passive (charm); our Tier 4 page lists it as a technique from a tier D source.

skills.effect: Single-target 3-hit thunder that triggers Radiance Sear; best value rainbow skill at tier 4. Replaced by Heaven's Wrath Thunder at tier 6.
Triggers an AoE when a hit crits; core of stage pushing at tiers 4-5; needs high crit rate.
skills.notes: CN guides describe a crit-triggered passive.

skills.effect: Gives a shield when HP drops by 15%; triggers repeatedly against many small hits. Standard survival passive through tier 7.
Active damage reduction; slot 1 of the tier-6 all-element build.
Raises wind damage with a chance to add Laceration; core of the tier-5 wind kiting build. One CN guide files it under tier 4, another under tier 5.
Direct damage reduction plus displacement; the skill that keeps its value longest for stage pushing and PvP; mandatory in PvP builds through tier 7.
Very large AoE with a small knockback and a small chance of Laceration; standard stage-pushing skill once rainbow; still used at tier 8.
0 cooldown, high multiplier and base value; forces the caster to step back after use.
High damage, castable at the start of battle ("potato mine").
skills.notes: Our data also has the name Explosive Spirit; one of them.

skills.effect: 3-hit high-multiplier AoE, 2-turn cooldown, can trigger Fire Core.
Core fire passive: large fire affinity and releases Blast Spirit. Nerfed at tier 6 (needs six turns for the full bonus).
skills.notes: Our translation: Flint Fire Spirit. Possibly the global charm Ember Flare (guess).

skills.effect: Frequent small-AoE added light damage; strongest light added-damage passive through tier 6; core for Hieromon damage.
High multiplier, bounces 3 times; best against three large enemies.
skills.notes: Our translation: Hundred-Burst Light. Possibly the global Starlight Burst (guess).

skills.effect: Thunder bow; applies Shock from slot 2; group-fight alternative to Light Ripple at tier 7.
skills.notes: Our translation: Thunder Bow (player short name).

skills.effect: Thunder strike that combines with Ice Ward for a freeze-then-reflect combo.
"Fridge" passive: damage reduction and healing for the water front-line build.
Blocks one skill hit ("small Unyielding"); taken against Sages and one-shot threats.
New Divine Wrath: 2-turn cooldown, 9 hits, very high damage; mandatory against Hieromon; strongest light active at tier 6.
skills.notes: Our translation: Heaven's Wrath Thunder (players: 神雷).

skills.effect: 4 high-damage hits in a very small area; duel skill.
High multiplier with a chance to Freeze; castable on the opening turn.
skills.notes: Our translation: Extreme Frost Spike. Our data lists a tier-5 technique Frost Thorn that may be this skill (guess).

skills.effect: Applies Burn and leaves a stable 9-tile fire field; upgraded Meteoric Flames; combo with Flame-Gathering Burst.
skills.notes: Our translation: Burning Dark Fire (players: 暗火).

skills.effect: Absorbs Burn to raise its damage and breaks shields; core burst of tier 6; at tier 8 it is the last skill of the "consume fire" build.
skills.notes: Our translation: Flame-Gathering Burst. Possibly the global Fiery Burst (guess).

skills.effect: Applies Wet; weaker than Extreme Frost Spike; opener that raises freeze chance.
Water Momentum: after enough water techniques it gives a large damage burst and control. Basis of the strongest ranking-damage builds at tiers 6-8; upgraded at tier 7.
skills.notes: Our translation: Torrent Momentum (players: 水势).

skills.effect: Fire-spirit damage passive: takes 3 turns to start; the spirit tracks enemies within 3 tiles.
Raises elemental resistance and gives action points when hit; semi-tank water passive.
Raises Laceration damage; adds a Laceration stack when Airborne triggers; replaces the knockback passive against Sages.

Raises the stats of all four elements after one cast ("Elemental Harmony Pro Max"); the only general damage passive of tier 6 and the skill said to keep its value best; conflicts with Formation Breaker.
Adds light damage; each skill cast adds a stack, 4 stacks boost the next light skill.
The Sorcerer's only self-heal: heals from fire tiles ("lay fire, regain HP").
skills.notes: Our translation: Flame Respite. Tier not stated.

skills.effect: "Electric Net": 2-turn cooldown, very high multiplier, damage does not decay and is unaffected by passives. Top investment priority at tiers 7 and 8.
skills.notes: Our translation: Thunder Net (players: 电网).

skills.effect: 4 hits (first three deal triple damage); best on maps with many bosses.
Tier-7 sigil: a very large amount of elemental mastery for every build; flat value, so its share shrinks late in a season. Sigils also give accuracy and crit damage.
skills.notes: Our translation: Sigil Fusion. Also written 魔纹通合.

skills.effect: Upgrade of Radiance Sear: a gold copy is about as strong as a rainbow Radiance Sear; can Cripple.
Stronger Water Momentum; with a new 0-cooldown water skill it beats the old Water Shot set-up for ranking damage.
Fire-affinity passive.
Higher numbers than older wind skills; weak passive part; used in slot 1 or 4 to keep distance.
Core of tier 8: burn-field mechanic that lets fire builds deal single-target damage; triggers repeatedly from fire tiles. First skill to take to rainbow.
skills.notes: Our translation: Ashland Domain (players: 疆域).

skills.effect: Strong AoE follow-up damage that cannot trigger passives; cast after fire-laying skills; mandatory for PvE.
Flame Domain guard: 4-tile range, up to +300% at full stacks and large damage reduction.
Wide fire-laying skill; optional AoE slot.
skills.notes: Our translation: Prairie Fire. Tier unclear in the source.

skills.effect: 2-turn cooldown, low damage; rated weak.
Absorbs nearby fire and revives at 50% HP after about 2 idle turns; group PvP and PvE survival.
skills.notes: Player nickname "phoenix egg"; real name not given.

skills.effect: No damage; applies Blind (rainbow copy); PvP only, not advised for low spenders.
Large AoE that can Root; boosted by Water Momentum.
Mid-size AoE with about 40% base Freeze chance.
0 cooldown; counts as two skills toward Water Momentum.
Root and Frost Mark plus a damage increase; mandatory for water builds.
Base damage reduction, and part of incoming damage (10%, +5% per extra offensive water technique, 30% with four) is deferred over three turns; prevents one-shots; preferred in PvP.
For every 10% of HP lost, damages nearby enemies and knocks them back; triggers many times; main stage-pushing damage source of wind builds at tier 8.
0 cooldown, 1-3 random hits, mostly Laceration damage.
6-tile pull-style passive used with the old Repelling Wind against Duelists and Knights.
Erosion (damage-over-time) passive; core of the Shadow Priest erosion build from tier 2; still required by the tier-7 group erosion charm.
Erosion-build filler active.
Large healing bonus; healer passive through tier 8.
Revives a fallen ally; taken by healers in dungeons at every tier.
Erosion-spread passive (fixed 60% chance after a rework).
Overheal passive for healers.
Summon that heals the whole team and dispels; used by all three Sage styles; still a utility pick at tier 7.
After death: large damage bonus and a short revival ("Revenge"). Core of direct-damage builds from tier 3 to tier 8.
Detonates Erosion stacks; finisher of the erosion build.
Dark-affinity passive; overtaken by Shadow-Devouring Undercurrent at tier 5.
Totem that triggers Soul Pact Resonance and advances the action bar.
Damage active swapped in when healing is not needed.
Direct-damage active of the tier-3 kit.

One of the strongest damage passives in the game: large attack bonus while a summon is alive (about +40-50% late, near double early when rainbow). Top voucher target at tier 4 and still central at tier 8.
Turns overflow healing into shields; healer core; only healers should invest.
Direct damage buff, can target self or a teammate; used through tier 7 in support set-ups.
The Sage's damage-reduction passive at tiers 4-5; weak against enemies that cannot be poisoned.
Only 0-cooldown heal (single target); triggers Overhealing.
Tank summon with good HP and defence, low speed.
Single target, 3 hits, 1-turn cooldown; mandatory in the erosion direct-damage build at tier 4.
"Scarecrow": decoy with 60% of the caster's stats; boss raids and PvP; called one of the Sage's two over-tuned mechanic skills even at tier 8.
2-turn cooldown damage active; only useful at tier 4.
Rated useless at tier 4.
Random stat buff; do not invest.
Summon-related heal; rated useless.
Core AoE of tier 5: 4 hits, full damage only when the target has three different debuffs. Later nerfed because it stacked poison.
Direct-damage finisher; damage rises as enemy HP falls; last slot.
Shadow Priest core damage with a random debuff; still used with the tier-7 link mechanic.
Very high-damage, very fragile summon (50% of base HP); best trigger for Soul Pact Resonance when chasing damage.
More dark affinity than Night's Blessing and explodes on kill; carried by almost every damage build.
skills.notes: Our translation: Shadow-Devouring Undercurrent. Also written 影蚀暗流.

skills.effect: Lowers effect resistance and applies 25% Vulnerability; used by every build; needs a high rarity for the erosion build.
skills.notes: Our translation: Ring of Ill Omen.

skills.effect: Best heal of tier 5: bounces between targets.
Healing potion skill for short fights (potion cap later raised to 5).
Summoner core; high damage but slow to start (2-3 turns).
PvP-oriented, unused at tier 5.
Summon passive of little value.
Applies Erosion to attackers; PvP pick for long fights.
The only direct damage-reduction passive; general defensive core.
Lifesteal and damage after 8 skill casts including dark skills; sustain for stage pushing; a tier-6 skill that only becomes worth using at tier 8.
"Dart": 0 cooldown, 2 Erosion applications; erosion core.
"Cross": direct-damage core, 2-turn cooldown.
Erosion AoE; opener at tier 8 for double hits and fast stacking.
Group heal plus group dispel; healer core.
Summoner AoE source.
Summoner AoE source.
Raises summon attack and advances the Fantomon's action bar; summoner core.
New erosion passive with a low trigger rate.
Dark damage next to summons; low numbers.
Healer damage-reduction buff with strict conditions (faster than the ally, 50%, 1 turn).
"Link": each debuff applied by a technique has about a 50% chance to deal direct damage. The main direct-damage source at tiers 7 and 8 and the core of the merged "debuff Sage" style.
0-cooldown group debuff; core of the link build.
Bouncing group direct damage, multi-hit on large enemies; rainbow full stacks about 550%.
Single-target debuff plus damage; fits all three styles; cannot lock large enemies.
Group erosion passive; needs the tier-2 and tier-3 erosion charms beside it.
Spirit Armour summon: 0 cooldown, 100% taunt in PvE, gives block (50) and block resistance (75); protects the party better than a Knight companion.
Guardian Totem: team utility in group PvP; paired with Spirit Armour for stage pushing.
Healer utility added at tier 7.
Summon sustain passive for long fights.
2-turn cooldown, high numbers, applies debuffs and triggers Link; random targeting; highest rainbow priority (already nerfed in testing).
AoE, 1-turn cooldown, applies Eternal Night (永夜: the tier-8 replacement for Erosion, 8 turns, last 4 doubled); mandatory for stage pushing.
0 cooldown, 1x5 line, about 40% base chance of Eternal Night; triggers Link often.
Target-locked; gives the enemy a stacking mark; decent multiplier without stacks; does not trigger Link.
0-cooldown double heal; healers take it to rainbow.
Damage summon without a turn limit; summoner style is weak at tier 8.
+8% attack per stack up to 5 (40%) and effect accuracy; obtained from the codex; rainbow early.
Healer version of the Knight's team-protection passives; very strong; active from the codex unlock.
Healer-only damage reduction for group PvP.
Group self-heal (about 6% healing at 30 stacks); rated weak.
Summons a fragile Shadow Fiend; rated weak.
